decisions.decision: The library's request for $15,000 from the reserve fund was not acted on. Kerry asked for more time to work out a plan, and Mark told the library the Town would not let any of its bills go unpaid while the approach is worked out.
decisions.quote: so kerry would like more time to work out a plan to deal with this issue.

decisions.decision: General approval (no recorded motion) for extending the capital project planning horizon from five years to ten years.

budget_items.topic: Fire and Police vehicle maintenance projected overage
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fire and Police vehicle maintenance is projected over budget by $8,000 - $10,000, though Town-wide vehicle maintenance is not projected over budget.

budget_items.topic: Library electricity and natural gas reserve fund request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library requested $15,000 from the reserve fund to cover higher electricity and natural gas costs; no transfer was approved.
budget_items.quote: requested $15,000 from the reserve fund to cover increases in electricity

budget_items.topic: Library state grant minimum budget effect
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Approving a transfer to the library could raise the minimum required library budget for state grants; the estimated FY16 increase in that minimum is $4,000.
Projected FY15 Veterans' Benefits costs are $20,000 over budget; the State reimburses the Town 75% of the cost, but only in the following fiscal year.
budget_items.quote: projected costs of veterans' benefits in fy15 is $20,000 over budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A potential overage of $12,000 in health care insurance costs, which the Town will try to mitigate within the overall budget.
budget_items.quote: there is a potential overage in health care insurance costs of $12,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Increased school choice students and other overages create a potential overspend of about $100,000.
budget_items.quote: the potential for an over spend of about $100,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash will help meet potential FY15 overages but may be lower going into FY16, affecting FY16 capital funding; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the town has free cash that will help meet potential overages in fy15

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The budget for new capital projects, including pavement management, is $850,000, being the $1,000,000 total less $150,000 in debt service from borrowing; this may change during the budget process.
budget_items.quote: $1,000,000 less $150,000 in debt service costs from borrowing for capital projects.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The top nine of 25 capital requests cost nearly $850,000 in total; the street sweeper, the tenth priority, costs $180,000.
budget_items.quote: the top nine priority projects cost nearly $850,000 in total.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The street sweeper is the tenth priority capital item and costs $180,000; the CPC recommends purchasing it through borrowing only if the Town projects sufficient funds in FY15 and beyond.
budget_items.quote: the street sweeper is the tenth priority item and costs $180,000.

budget_items.topic: DPW backhoe and dump truck borrowing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The CPC recommends borrowing to finance the DPW backhoe ($120,000) and dump truck ($190,000).
budget_items.quote: the cpc recommends borrowing to finance the backhoe ($120,000) and dump truck ($190,000)

budget_items.topic: Minimum borrowing amount for capital projects
budget_items.what_was_recorded: $100,000 is the minimum the Town would use borrowing to fund; the goal was to fund much more expensive projects.
budget_items.quote: -$100,000 is the minimum the town would use

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Concern that out-year costs of this year's borrowing would constrain the Town's ability to replace the ladder truck for $850,000.
budget_items.quote: truck for $850,000 or other expensive projects.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: With paraprofessionals added to the FY15 budget, the FY16 school budget as of that meeting is a 9% increase over FY14.
budget_items.quote: budget for the schools as of that meeting is a 9% increase over fy14.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Green Community has bids for LED parking lot lights and has a significant amount of money to spend; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: they have a significant amount of money and are looking for more projects to do.

transfers.description: Library request for reserve fund money to cover higher electricity and natural gas costs from increased utility rates
transfers.outcome: Not approved; no transfer made. Kerry asked for more time to work out a plan, and the Finance Committee's practice is to approve reserve fund transfers toward the end of the year.
transfers.quote: requested $15,000 from the reserve fund to cover increases in electricity
